Hi Bettina, I can't set up the recurring digest yet. The scheduler I'd use to post it every Monday at 08:00 is refusing my connection because the gateway has no credentials configured. I haven't tried to change that config. Someone with gateway access needs to fix it, then I'll set up the job. Until then, nothing will post automatically.

Here's what I'd set up once it works:

- **When:** Mondays at 08:00 Central (the company time zone), starting Monday 19 October 2026.
- **Where:** posted here in #coastal-team.
- **What:** the past week's activity from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items.
- **Limits:** finance figures (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts, payment terms) and finance documents stay out of the digest. They would need Anselm or June's approval to appear in this channel. Operational facts like seat counts, renewal dates, ticket numbers and contacts are fine.

Both channels have the same four members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so nothing in the digest goes beyond who can already see these channels.
